more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Triethyl citrate is the triethyl ester of citric acid, supplied as a practically colourless oily liquid. The specified material is supplied as colourless liquid. EU permissions include processed eggs and egg products, food supplements supplied in a solid form excluding food supplements for infants and  young children’,.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain food supplements supplied in a solid form, excluding food supplements for infants and young children; processed eggs and egg products.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
